☆Estimated playing time⏰☆

Normal: 2 hours (It requires both upgrades and money, and is recommended for players who want to experience simple combat failure)

A psychological journey through suspense, supernatural horror, and forbidden desire awaits you. Elton Manor: Requiem of the Cursed Roses is set to launch later this year—inviting you into a haunted estate where death and longing intertwine at every turn.

[h1]🕯️ A Strange Identity, A Familiar Danger[/h1]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45434844/a1cc29ab0506be7dcd344c71f01ac2a3e9405581.jpg[/img]

The story begins in a mysterious century-old mansion, filled with whispers of the dead. The protagonist, An, wakes up after a strange incident—only to realize that everyone sees him as a maid named Anna. Forced to take on this identity, he must carry out daily chores while secretly uncovering the truth about his past. But this house is far from peaceful.

[h1]🔍 A Locked Room, A Vanished Truth[/h1]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45434844/3859c9d469eb23e77f375e51eee18398ee2025d1.jpg[/img]

The first murder strikes on the night of a family reunion. The master of the house is found dead in a locked room—his body twisted, the cause unknown. The case seems eerily connected to a long-standing legend within the estate:
Years ago, the master was rumored to have had a secret romance with a maid. When his wife found out, the maid was tormented relentlessly and eventually threw herself into the well. They say her vengeful spirit still wanders the halls, searching for a replacement... to finish what was never avenged.
Was it premeditated murder?Or has something returned... from the well?

[h1]💔 Dangerous Gazes, Tender Lies[/h1]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45434844/e63c76193ae901d105edf0bc451392767af70157.jpg[/img]

Trapped in the guise of a maid and surrounded by suspicion, An finds himself at the center of two men’s growing interest:
Aaron, the calm and distant grandson of the deceased master, quietly watches over him.
Shen Minghao, a mysterious business associate, claims to be there to "save" him.
Can either of them be trusted?
Are they allies, lovers… or the very hands behind the bloodshed?
Every emotion hides a motive.
Every lie has consequences.

[h1]🕸️ Step Into a Nightmare You Can’t Escape[/h1]

Elton Manor: Requiem of the Cursed Roses is now available for Steam wishlist! More game info, visuals, and demo updates are coming soon. If you love suspense, horror, and emotional BL storytelling, don’t miss this descent into a haunted past.

[h1]💌◆Story💌[/h1]
18 years ago, Cardinal Gilbert was punished by the archbishop for committing a mistake in the capital's archdiocese. He was demoted to the remote seaside town of Kynaston, where he would succeed the deceased ex-bishop and govern for 20 years.

Time passed by quickly, and Kynaston became a prosperous commercial town. The daughter he had adopted from the orphanage here, Emily, also celebrated her 18th birthday.

Without a "Blessed Girl"—an agent appointed as the saint guardian by the goddess Aphro —for a long time, the town would inevitably fall back into poverty and destruction!⚡.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45434844/662aae614300857b70799607e01c72a5fa4d9823.png[/img]

Gilbert, who observed that Emily was no less qualified than any previous saints, decided to make her a saint. However, as she was not a blessed girl, she faced opposition from the believers. Thus, he made an agreement with everyone that if she could not be acknowledged within two years, she would step down from the position of saint.

While Gilbert was guiding Emily to become a saint, an intruder appeared in the church! He was so elusive that he successfully escaped the church's pursuit again and again, giving Gilbert a headache. What was his purpose...!?

Two years were neither long nor short, and the time the two had to spend together was gradually running out. Would Emily be able to overcome the many difficulties and break the myth among believers that "an unblessed girl could not be a saint?" Would she realize her dream?

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45434844/cd75808fcf12b4b350256a775af9378b3419331b.png[/img]

[h1]✨◆Gameplay Instructions✨[/h1]
Every day is divided into three time periods. Players will take on the role of the bishop of Kynaston Town. Within two years, he should guide and train Emily to carry out various activities in the church or go out onto the streets to try various jobs and increase their income. Some actions will be unlocked as the plot develops.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45434844/5de08837e3e525539b5c48719b00b574de232a7c.jpg[/img]

After accumulating enough funds, you can invest in the expansion of the church and give Emily a better learning environment, increasing her learning and working efficiency💗.

You should not neglect your interactions with Emily. Interact with her enough to maintain your relationship or bring her even closer to you!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45434844/1143634a3ff8e7be80d0d46bba36c635d2563f54.gif[/img]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/35300011/a439309fd779f59910ea9d3ec5c02bdf0a1f7e7f.png[/img]

[h1]🩺◆Story🩺[/h1]

Cyclops, the city of eyes, was an ancient city with thousands of years of history, and it was also a pioneer in the transformation of the industrial revolution. On this stage, where history and technology intertwined, the stories of countless characters rose and fell in the noise and silence.

Dr. Etsu wasn't a star of the show or in the limelight, but his role was more dramatic than anyone else's. When he left academia in a state of despair, he was approached by a mysterious woman who called herself a "god" and gave him a pair of eyes with special powers. Years later, relying on the magic of his eyes and his solid medical skills, he became one of the most successful doctors in the city.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/35300011/f20934da7d96c566ee35749d6249690ad9eb8195.jpg[/img]

However, perhaps as his price to pay, every night in his dreams, Etsu always found himself in a room without a door, waiting for his patient: the mysterious maiden, Angus.

Angus suffered from an unknown, chronic illness, and no amount of medical expertise could relieve her of her pain, but she still welcomed Etsu's visits with a smile every day. Night after night, the two of them made diagnoses and talked to each other, where Angus learnt about the outside world from Etsu, and Etsu found solace in his contact with the young girl👁️‍🗨️.

In order to find a cure for Angus, Etsu followed the guidance in his dreams and leaped into the various stories of the city of Cyclops. The old hero of the old town, the homeless girl of the deserted metal district, the detective on the train, the scholar of the university city… As key supporting characters on this stage, what changes would Etsu bring to their scripts?

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/35300011/7f03985e9624dc3cee6fa51fcc5ea76d66485427.jpg[/img]

Open your eyes; the show is about to begin.

[h1]🔍◆Gameplay🔍[/h1]

The main storyline will consist of four areas in the city of Cyclops. As the story progresses, areas will be opened up for exploration, and you will be able to interact with the characters in the areas and make choices that will affect their stories.
The choices you make will affect Angus’ health and the final ending.
Use your eyes’ ability to see into the human body and beyond, into past scenes to learn more about the stories and find clues.
Enter the dream world during the nighttime, and interact with Angus by chatting with and diagnosing her🩹.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/35300011/cd03169f63b3a3984c194c66c17df9f2e6f6d29b.jpg[/img]

[h1]💊◆Game Features💊[/h1]

◇ Drama-themed exploration game, exploring four areas of the city at different times
◇ 17 basic CGs, including more than 100 differentials and 3 motion CGs
◇ Wordcount: 110,000
◇ One main female character, one secondary female character, and many female side characters (Mainly a one-on-one, loyal love story)💗
◇ Game ending: Three types

notes.title: 【Playmeow】Four beautiful women from the Romance of the Three Kingdoms bring you a new game of romance💘《Liu Shan Maker》Officially released🎊!!
notes.content:

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/35300011/9f71ef5269624b666df1786da60adf02edb695a7.png[/img]

[h1]🐎◆ Story🐎[/h1]

During the Three Kingdoms era, warlords vied for supremacy, aspiring to unify the Central Plains through strategy and warfare. Yet, amidst the continuous conflict, the long-awaited era of peace and prosperity for the common people remained elusive. The chaos of the Three Kingdoms entered its latter stage after enduring years of incessant battles.

In the year 223 AD, on his deathbed, the ailing Emperor Liu Bei entrusted me with the care of his orphaned daughter, Liu Shan, to assist her in ruling and even suggested my intervention in case of her inability to lead. However, as his most loyal advisor, I could not entertain such thoughts. My true aspiration is to groom Liu Shan into a beloved and capable Empress, fostering Shu Han into a powerful nation capable of unifying the realm. This is my life's greatest ambition.

However, nothing unfolds as easily as envisioned. Ambitious stepsons eyeing power, rebellions in the southern regions, rebellious generals, and the invasion by Cao Wei posed successive challenges upon Liu Shan's ascension…

Amidst internal strife and external threats, what choices should I make to lead Shu Han toward an era of peace and prosperity while nurturing Liu Shan to become a wise and benevolent Empress?

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/35300011/b0f6d19a744e0ea516e4d606a842c51231eb73cc.png[/img]

[h1]🌟◆ Gameplay🌟[/h1]

Players take on the role of Zhuge Liang, supporting Liu Shan's reign as the Chancellor of Shu Han, nurturing her into an exceptional Empress capable of unifying the realm during tumultuous times. They must navigate the challenges faced by the nation.

Each month in the game allows decisions on two national policies and three arrangements for Liu Shan's development. Policy decisions impact the nation's metrics while nurturing Liu Shan involves choices between "Studying," "Conversations," "Outings," and "Rest," enabling her to lead a balanced life and foster goodwill. Every decision and arrangement influences the destiny of Liu Shan and the nation.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/35300011/9113fa692d0581b5e8fe9ff786a7d21f9a9032e1.png[/img]

[h1]🐉◆ Game Features🐉[/h1]

◇ Management and cultivation gameplay
◇ One main female character and three secondary female characters
◇ Word Count: 150,000 words
◇ Game Endings: 10 variations

Dr. Etsu wasn't a star of the show or in the limelight, but his role was more dramatic than anyone else's. When he left academia in a state of despair, he was approached by a mysterious woman who called herself a "god" and gave him a pair of eyes with special powers. Years later, relying on the magic of his eyes and his solid medical skills, he became one of the most successful doctors in the city💉.

However, perhaps as his price to pay, every night in his dreams, Etsu always found himself in a room without a door, waiting for his patient: the mysterious maiden, Angus.

In order to find a cure for Angus💊, Etsu followed the guidance in his dreams and leaped into the various stories of the city of Cyclops. The old hero of the old town, the homeless girl of the deserted metal district, the detective on the train, the scholar of the university city… As key supporting characters on this stage, what changes would Etsu bring to their scripts?

[h1]🎤◆ Story🎤[/h1]

Due to a car accident, Ethan Davis and his younger sister Luna Davis became orphans who depended on each other. Having lost his father, Ethan took the responsibility of taking care of his sister. While searching for the possibilities in pop music, Ethan had to bring along his sister, who was very fond of him, to make their way into the music industry and seek the path to success🎟️.

In Super Idol, you will take on the role of a music producer and challenge the boundaries of morality and power in the glamourous world of show business🎭.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/35300011/a9c0b59ab16dc463fe12497a605d2ab7817603b2.jpg[/img]

[h1]🎶◆ Gameplay🎶[/h1]

The game is divided into three years, with six stages per year. Players will be faced with many choices, which will be able to influence their own destiny and that of their sister. Choose a partner between a legendary musician and a down-and-out singer, aim towards turning your sister into a super idol, choose from ideals, desires, and reality, and take your sister on a journey into the great music industry💎!

In the game, the eligible characters include your sister Luna, two chorus singers, Josie Ray and Shirley Lawson, music producer Daphne Briggs, and singer Little Candy. Depending on their choices, the player will also change the fate of their sister, Luna, and bring her to meet all kinds of people.

Whether to stick to the original goal of making good music, or to play with the hidden rules, or even to go beyond the boundary of siblings to live a life that breaks the taboo of the society💍, all will depend on the player's choices.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/35300011/60ecee4a4ea35ef2a78c13130d973acce78e2aa6.jpg[/img]

[h1]💗◆Story💗[/h1]
Growing up in quite a wealthy, lovely family, I thought that everything would be alright, as it is now.
But then the accident happened…

"It was so painful, so hopeless. I couldn't breathe; my heart felt like it was going to explode. I didn't want to hear anything..."

"Nothing matters anymore."🎈

An accident took away my family, my life, my everything. All that remained were the eyes that could no longer see a clear view of the world. I was abandoned by the world; I have no value of existence.

But I met you, the one who saved me. You are my only light, pulling my hand to go forward.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/35300011/328c7e08e815486cc22f1f718e5c467ccf7dff73.jpg[/img]

Thus, I live together with the devil King of the other world, getting to know each other in life and having an adventure together that I'd never thought of in my life.

But the more I try to understand you, the more I feel that you are suffering more than I thought.
You are also an abandoned person.
The burden of the country, the distrust of the people, and the hunting of the heroes… All that you have endured is not for one person to bear.

Flan, This time, it's my turn to save you.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/35300011/7c0603827d508b8dbfad2ef4cff0bd71a09b20ba.jpg[/img]

[h1]🚪◆Gameplay🚪[/h1]
In a limited time, help Flan to repair the Otherworld Gate and return to the original world. In the process of repairing the door, come to understand Flan.

Players can get to know Flan better by "talking," "interacting," "giving gifts," and "dating," in which other characters will appear. You will be able to interact with other characters in specific ways. There are also objects in the scenes that can be investigated, and the results of the investigation may make your interactions with Flan easier🎁.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/35300011/224e22fef3e4fd8f79030058dfd0f76fb7709c34.jpg[/img]

As time progresses, , there will be different characters and scenes to explore and investigate. You are also able to gradually understand the sorrows of Flan, under the double wrapping of internal and external problems which constitute more than just the plot of love.

Each conversation and each event will let the player understand more about the woman who seems strong, but also needs the help in front of them🌺.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/35300011/5a5fab110f585220d0e002b1b3740c4353528f8d.jpg[/img]

[h1]💄◆Game Features💄[/h1]
◇23 basic CGs, including more than 200 differentials
◇120,000 words of game text
◇One main female character and two secondary female characters
◇Pure love plot, experiencing two different worlds

Snow was innocent and lovely – gentle but with a little devilish character. She had a smile like the sunshine, but she looked sad at some points.

And what about me? What were my feelings for Snow?

So, in return for dealing with their mess, how about they pay for it with ...?

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35300011/cefc56136f6f4bb86a67594bcca996fa71ef5927.png[/img]

[h1]【Story Theme】[/h1]
Distinct from previous works, this game features a love adventure story with a wuxia theme and rich content.

The story depicts Gong Zhen, a young martial arts novice who has just entered the ambiguous world of Jianghu. He accidentally gets involved in a series of shocking cases and encounters two powerful female figures in the realm.

"Singing in the dead of night, accompanied by a beautiful lady."
"The young man travels the Jianghu with his sword, where does his journey end?"
"The long road ahead, dust-stained and weary."
"I raise a toast to you and we compose the dreams of chivalry."

Will Gong Zhen be able to embrace the beauties and become a lucky guy who enjoys all the blessings? It all depends on the skills of you, the experienced players!

[h1]【Gameplay】[/h1]
The gameplay features turn-based combat with different skill combinations by switching team formations. Players must carefully consider skill combinations and positioning when facing powerful enemies to achieve victory.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35300011/b2de0a0a5bec9edf15dfff8c7843af94fddecd38.png[/img]

Be sure to prepare your team well before battle.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35300011/5bbf5a542b999e2ff1d80cc03657878eab43a96b.png[/img]

As for the exploration mode, it adopts a style similar to passing five levels, revealing the next path with obtainable items or enemies as you progress. Many hidden events and achievements await players to uncover.
